en-US.title: Tabula Medica
en-US.subtitle: Health records, any language
en-US.description:
Tabula Medica puts your complete health records in your hands — in any of 52 languages. Designed for everyone, especially the underserved, because the poorest of the poor deserve health records in their own language.

IMPORT YOUR RECORDS AUTOMATICALLY
Connect to over 50,000 hospitals, clinics, and pharmacies through the national TEFCA network. No portal passwords needed — we find your records automatically.

COMPLETE HEALTH RECORD
- Medications, allergies, lab results, immunizations
- Clinical notes, procedures, vital signs
- Insurance cards and claims
- Medical documents and imaging

52 LANGUAGES
Every record, every insight, every notification — translated into your preferred language. From Arabic to Vietnamese, Tabula Medica speaks your language.

AI-POWERED INSIGHTS
- Plain-language explanations of lab results
- Medication interaction alerts
- Personalized health timeline
- Duplicate test prevention

PRIVACY & SECURITY FIRST
- HIPAA and HITECH 2026 compliant
- Biometric authentication (Face ID / Touch ID)
- End-to-end encryption for all health data
- SOC 2 certified infrastructure
- You own your data — always

INTEROPERABILITY
- FHIR R4 and USCDI v6 standards
- TEFCA Trusted Exchange Framework
- SMART on FHIR integration
- Share records with any provider instantly

FAMILY CARE
- Manage records for family members
- Emergency contact sharing
- Caregiver access controls

Tabula Medica is built on the belief that access to your own health information is a fundamental right — regardless of language, income, or where you live.

review.notes:
LOGIN STEPS:
1. Launch the app.
2. On the welcome screen, tap "Sign in with Email".
3. Enter the reviewer credentials provided via secure channel and tap "Sign In".
4. The reviewer account is pre-loaded with sample health records (visits, labs, medications) so all features can be exercised immediately.

This account uses email/password authentication only. No phone verification, MFA challenge, or HealthKit/contacts permissions are required to log in. After logging in, optional permissions (Face ID, HealthKit, Notifications) can be granted from Settings to exercise those features.

ABOUT THE APP:
Tabula Medica is a personal health record (PHR) app that allows patients to import their medical records from hospitals and clinics through the TEFCA national network. The app accesses HealthKit data only with explicit user permission. All data is encrypted end-to-end and the app is HIPAA / HITECH 2026 compliant.

IN-APP PURCHASES:
All paid features (Medical Pro tier) are sold exclusively through StoreKit / RevenueCat — there are no external payment links inside the app.

CONTACT:
If the reviewer account does not work, contact us at the support email and phone number listed in this App Review Information submission. We respond within one business hour during US business hours.
